faq.heading: If it crossed your mind, we have an answer

items.a: You get a working prototype in 3-4 weeks. The full process - strategic spec plus design - runs one to three months, depending on scope.
An interactive prototype you can click and feel. A strategic spec document, design files, and clear guidelines - so you can keep going on your own.

items.q: I’ve been through a spec process before. Why would this be different?
items.a: Because this time, you see it before you commit. Forget the PDF that gets archived - you get a working prototype you can touch and respond to in real time.

items.q: What’s the difference between a prototype and a finished product?
items.a: A prototype is an interactive model that simulates the real user experience. It’s not final code - but it lets you feel, test, and refine before you invest in development.
Every project is priced by size and complexity. We’d love to hear what you’re building - and from there, we tailor a precise quote.

items.q: What happens after I have the prototype?
items.a: You move into development with all the files and documentation. You’re not locked in - but we’re around if you want us with you through design and dev too.

caseFincat.lede: A financial-comparison brand reimagined - a new brand foundation, a full UX/UI system, and a marketing engine that runs itself. Strategy and design didn’t hand off; they ran in parallel, each one sharpening the other.
caseFincat.glanceTitle: An established brand that needed to feel new.
caseFincat.glanceBody: FinCat helps people find the right financial service providers, with verified ratings. The product worked - but the brand and the site no longer matched the business, and there was no marketing engine behind it. We rebuilt all three at once.
caseFincat.challengeTitle: Two hard constraints, one moving target.
caseFincat.challengeBody: We had to lift an existing visual language - keeping the cat mascot and the black, yellow and white palette people already recognized - while designing the entire site before its custom illustrations existed. And we had to do it for more than one audience at the same time, without losing the thread of a single, coherent brand.
caseFincat.approachTitle: The Spiral, not the relay race.
caseFincat.approachBody: Most studios run strategy, then design, then marketing - each one waiting on the last. We work in a spiral: the tracks move together and refine as they go, so a decision in one immediately sharpens the other. On FinCat that wasn’t a slogan - it’s literally how the work got made.
caseFincat.workedBody: Strategy and design weren’t separate deliverables - they fed each other, step by step. Here’s the back-and-forth that built FinCat.

loops.keren: Built FinCat a brand foundation from scratch - values, vision, brand story and a shared terminology - even though the brand already existed.
loops.amir: Turned that terminology into the product itself: UI labels, microcopy and a visual language that says the same thing the brand does.
Designed a clickable prototype of the whole site - every page, before a single illustration existed.
loops.keren: Used those real screens to pressure-test funnel messaging and CTAs, so the words were proven before development began.
Mapped the audiences into personas and segments, each with its own funnel and intent.
loops.amir: Shaped onboarding and flows around those personas, so each visitor meets the screen built for them.
Built a tailor-made icon set and component system for the site.
loops.keren: Carried it straight into landing pages, email sequences and paid assets - one brand language, everywhere.

caseFincat.loopNote: Neither track could have produced this result on its own.
caseFincat.showcaseTitle: Brand, product and engine - in one voice.
caseFincat.resultsTitle: A brand that finally matches the business.

results.p: From values to UI labels to ad copy - the same voice everywhere, built on a foundation that didn’t exist before.
A clickable prototype let messaging and flows get tested on real screens, so development started from certainty.

results.b: A marketing engine that runs itself
results.p: Modular funnels and automations turn one click into a pre-planned set of actions across every platform.

caseTradePool.lede: A day-trading platform that gives traders unlimited buying power and guidance from pros. The catch: two weeks to invent a whole design language - bold and cheeky, but still trustworthy with people’s money.
caseTradePool.role: UX/UI Strategy · Design System · Art Direction · Web Design
caseTradePool.timeline: ~1 month (2 weeks for the design language)
caseTradePool.glanceTitle: A young brand that still had to feel safe with your money.
caseTradePool.glanceBody: Trade The Pool lets day traders trade stocks with unlimited buying power and guidance from analysts with 15+ years of experience. The product is bold and youthful by nature - the design had to match that energy without losing the credibility a financial product needs.
caseTradePool.challengeTitle: Two weeks. Almost no brand. A blank page.
caseTradePool.challengeBody: With only a handful of brand values to go on, I had two weeks to invent a complete visual language from scratch - bold, young and memorable, yet credible enough for a financial product people trust with real money.
caseTradePool.approachTitle: Move fast, commit to a point of view.
caseTradePool.approachBody: No time to hedge. I explored two distinct directions, put a clear opinion behind each, and let the client choose - then built the chosen language all the way to a working prototype.
caseTradePool.processTitle: From a few brand values to a working site - solo.
steps: Turned the few brand values into a sharp creative brief: bold, young, memorable.
Explored two distinct design directions and presented each with a clear rationale.
Built the chosen language into a full design system - type, color, characters, components.
Designed the full site and a high-fidelity prototype, ready to hand to development.
caseTradePool.showcaseTitle: One bold language, end to end.
caseTradePool.resultsTitle: Young and bold - and still trustworthy.

results.p: A complete, distinctive visual identity created in two weeks, from almost nothing.
Cheeky characters and a bold palette that still read as a serious financial product.
A full design system and hi-fi prototype handed off, ready for development.

caseThatPerk.lede: An organizational ride-share platform that turns the daily commute into a perk. We shaped a product that gets employees carpooling - rewarding them with points and perks, and giving organizations a dashboard full of insight.
caseThatPerk.timeline: End to end - marketing site & product dashboard
caseThatPerk.glanceTitle: Carpooling people actually want to do.
caseThatPerk.glanceBody: ThatPerk helps organizations cut parking, traffic and emissions by making ride-share to work genuinely rewarding. Employees earn points and perks for sharing rides; the company gets a dashboard that turns everyday commutes into measurable impact.
caseThatPerk.challengeTitle: Make carpooling feel like a perk, not a chore.
caseThatPerk.challengeBody: Organizational ride-share usually fails because it asks people to give something up. The challenge was to flip that - design a product that makes sharing a ride the fun, obvious, rewarding choice for employees, while giving organizations clear proof of the savings.
caseThatPerk.approachBody: We built everything around a single idea - good for the employee, the organization and the environment. A bold, friendly brand for the marketing site, and a calm, data-rich dashboard for the people running it.
steps: Mapped the two audiences - the employees who ride, and the organization that runs it.
Shaped the win-win-win story and a bold, friendly visual language.
Designed the marketing site to sell the perk and book demos.
Designed the organizational dashboard - savings, distance and usage at a glance.
caseThatPerk.showcaseTitle: From the pitch to the dashboard.
caseThatPerk.resultsTitle: A commute perk people opt into.

results.p: One win-win-win narrative that lands with employees and decision-makers alike.
Points and rewards that make sharing a ride the fun, obvious choice.
A dashboard that turns everyday commutes into measurable savings and impact.
